verdict.rationale: The firm's own Venture & Growth Tech page says it advises on financing transactions "from seed capital to IPOs" at "all stages". It also states deal volume of more than 70 transactions a year and €9.2bn raised or invested, which meets the deal-volume requirement. missing for 10: explicit reference to priced equity rounds as such, named representative financing-round transactions (the only cited reference deal is an M&A exit), independent corroboration beyond the Chambers quote on the firm's own page.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages

citations.quote: We advise entrepreneurs and investors on structuring, negotiating and drafting all documentation for financing transactions, from seed capital to IPOs.
in all their transactions and at all stages of a growth company's development, from fundraising to exit.
On average, we oversee more than 70 transactions a year, amounting to more than €9.2 billion raised or invested by our clients over the past 18 years.
